summary: Independent review found no actionable defects in the current revision-22 desktop bootstrap. The main-frame preload guard and srcdoc regression probe address subframe bridge exposure. Prior available review findings and Windows dynamic-import corrections remain resolved in source. This verdict does not complete the desktop milestone.

method.spec_compliance: Compared implementation and recorded checks with revision-22 plan, current acceptance contract and final-code-review-packet-r7.json.
method.code_quality: Inspected preload, IPC admission and callers, renderer polling, sidecar startup/identity/cleanup, packaging, E2E scenarios, tests and configuration. Rechecked available prior findings and Windows file-URL dynamic imports.
method.execution_evidence: Read current-source ledger receipts for workspace checks, desktop tests, macOS development and packaged E2E, packaging and packaged renderer inspection; matching package and sidecar hashes were recorded.

resolved_findings.subframe_bridge: process.isMainFrame guards bridge exposure. The E2E bypasses CSP only for the probe, creates a srcdoc frame, verifies about:srcdoc and confirms desktopBridge is undefined, then removes the frame and restores CSP. Main-process admission independently requires the exact main frame.
resolved_findings.windows_dynamic_imports: package.mjs and inspect-packaged-bundle.mjs convert resolved module paths with pathToFileURL before dynamic import.
resolved_findings.prior_findings: Malformed-payload rejection, disconnect visibility and restart recovery, packaged startup/timeout/collision scenarios, artifact binding, setup-failure cleanup, Windows profile redirection, and recovery-path reporting remain in source.

limits: Reviewer did not run tests, build, application or GUI; execution conclusions are limited to coordinator-recorded receipts.
Windows runtime, packaging and filesystem behavior remain unverified on Windows.
The srcdoc probe verifies direct subframe bridge absence, not future preview-content isolation.
No independent visual or accessibility assessment was performed.
This pass does not establish full product completion, signing, public-release readiness or persistent personal-data behavior.
